comment:
§C, p. 199, lines 33–34. [highlight] On the text: «depends on knowing,».
this sounds as if this knowledge is the most decisive factor for progress towards UHC. 
But this type of "definition" for progress is not correct. 
UHC means that people can access quality health services without financial hardship.
